articles.headline: China unveils draft export controls on AI technologies and chips
articles.summary: China’s proposed export controls could constrain access to advanced AI technologies and semiconductor components, raising compliance and supply-chain risk for global companies. Businesses that rely on Chinese manufacturing, chip sourcing, or AI hardware should watch for procurement delays, licensing requirements, and cost increases.

articles.headline: UK regulator proposes strategic market status for Microsoft across Copilot and 365 ecosystem
articles.summary: The UK Competition and Markets Authority has provisionally designated Microsoft with strategic market status in business software, which could lead to tougher oversight of Copilot and Microsoft 365. That may affect pricing, interoperability, procurement strategy, and vendor lock-in decisions for organizations using Microsoft’s enterprise stack.

articles.headline: TSMC profits surge amid relentless AI demand
articles.summary: TSMC reported stronger-than-expected quarterly profits as AI chip demand remained exceptionally high, reinforcing the supply constraint story around advanced semiconductors. For businesses, this can mean continued pressure on AI infrastructure availability, higher hardware costs, and longer lead times for compute-heavy projects.
